To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the performance of a business process is positively related to the performance of an organization, but the strength of this relationship varies across industries, and (2) the performance of the business process is positively influenced by the use of business intelligence systems.
BI systems have the potential to provide significant value to organizations by improving their business process performance and, in turn, organizational performance.
